correctness.rationale: The two F4 residual geometric singularity types from Uppal have one singular point and separable double-plane equations. If Q2 has at least two F4 zeros, a rational lift is smooth. If it has one zero, Q2 is equivalent to x^2+xy+omega*y^2. Exact independently replayed 20x30 binary trace matrix has rank 19; the Artin-Schreier image has dimension 11 and equals its kernel. No rational unramified lift would force G4=omega*Q2^2+H^2+Q2*H, factoring the weighted equation geometrically, contrary to integrality. The supplied Python script verifies the only finite rank certificate.
